'''2000 Brisbane Grand Slam''' was the Star Wars CCG constructed event of a Grand Slam 2000 weekend, one of 31 Decipher special tournament weekends in 2000. The winner received a complete set of uncut sheets.<ref name="gs00">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Grand Slam 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010716001210/http://bbs.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="gs00cal">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Grand Slam calendar], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010311080940/http://calder.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Grand Slam (constructed)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' March 2000
* '''Site:''' Brisbane, Queensland, Australia

=== Location discrepancy ===
Decipher's Grand Slam 2000 list places this event in Brisbane. Josem's own DeckTech post of the winning Dark deck (14 March 2000) calls it "the Canberra Grand Slam".<ref name="dt-4336">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4336 Grand Slam Winner], DeckTech (Michael "Joz" Josem, 14 March 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/4336/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/4336/ GitHub Pages].</ref> The post may simply name the wrong city, or Decipher may have listed an event held in Canberra under Brisbane. Until more evidence turns up, this wiki follows Decipher's list.

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.
